step1_summary.chief_complaint: Diarrhea lasting for three days with abdominal pain and vomiting.

symptoms.alleviating_factors: Using the toilet, possibly passing gas

step1_summary.past_medical_history: Asthma, family history of bowel cancer (father)
step1_summary.family/social_history: Father died of bowel cancer 10 years ago, concerns about personal risk
step1_summary.vital_signs/exam_findings: Tummy pain focused in the center of the abdomen, no blood in stool or vomit, nausea present

I: Gastroenteritis: Symptoms of diarrhea, vomiting, and abdominal pain suggest an infection or inflammation of the gastrointestinal tract.

step3_ranked_ddx.explanation: The patient has diarrhea, vomiting, and abdominal pain lasting three days, which are classic symptoms of gastroenteritis.
opposing_evidence: No blood in stool or vomit, which can sometimes be present in more severe cases.
